response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure experience, particularly at re:cinq, where he contributes to Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic workflows. While his AI/GenAI experience is not as extensive as the 8-year requirement, his technical leadership, cloud platform exposure, and open-source contributions suggest he could quickly adapt. His background in designing scalable systems and mentoring teams aligns well with the role's responsibilities.
strengths: Proven technical leadership and mentorship across multiple roles, including staff-level positions.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) and cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes).
Strong full-stack development skills in TypeScript, Python-adjacent languages (DLang), and modern frameworks, with a focus on scalability and testing.
concerns: Only ~2 years of direct AI/GenAI experience (at re:cinq), falling short of the 8-year requirement.
Lacks explicit mention of vector databases or RAG architectures in resume, though may have exposure.
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI or related fields, which is preferred for this role.
